title: 2 Wheels 4 Purpose
summary: All digital for a 7,000 km cycle across Europe: website, SEO, social, and a custom CRM for riders, ambassadors and sponsors.
headline: Over €400k raised on a zero marketing budget
tags: Campaign strategy; Web; SEO; CRM; Copywriting
situation: A team of riders set out to cycle 7,000 km across Europe for breast cancer research. There was no marketing budget, so that every euro raised could go to the cause.
task: Lead all digital: messaging, the website and SEO, organic growth, and the systems to manage riders, ambassadors and sponsors.
action:
Defined the core messaging and voice for individual donors and for corporate sponsors.
Designed and built the website with localised SEO for each country on the route.
Grew reach through organic social and partner channels.
Built a custom CRM in OutSystems connecting Webflow, Koalect and every.org, with automated receipts, welcome series and live goal tracking.
Gave sponsors a private portal showing real-time reach and audience for assets carrying their logo.
result2_text: in 90% of key localised searches, and top five for every key term in every country the campaign ran in
result4_text: spent on media; digital delivered pro bono

title: Hoffmann Institute website
summary: A website for INSEAD's new sustainability institute, tagging and aggregating content against the UN SDGs.
headline: ~80% cheaper than agency bids, live in a month
tags: Strategy; UX / UI; Web development; Project management
situation: INSEAD's new Hoffmann Global Institute needed a site that could tag and aggregate content against the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Two agency proposals were over budget and timeline, and relied on offshore development that the communications and IT teams didn't want to inherit.
task: Brought in two weeks before the tender deadline, I had to find a route that satisfied the institute, communications and IT, within budget and without adding complexity to INSEAD's digital estate.
action:
Proposed an in-house, three-sprint plan: information architecture, design and build in Webflow, then migration to Drupal 8.
Built the design system, templates, widgets and CMS collections, and ran all client iteration before migration to avoid costly developer changes.
Designed automated workflows so a written post could become on-brand visuals, scheduled content and social posts, with editorial sign-off and an audit trail.
Migrated with INSEAD's developer team in Singapore, turning Webflow components into reusable Drupal modules.
result1_text: lower cost than the two agency proposals, with design and development brought in-house
result2_text: to a working first version the institute's team could populate
result3_text: on all four Google Lighthouse categories after the Drupal migration

result3_text: research centres supported with campaigns, content and event promotion

title: GeoLinks website and illustrations
summary: Website, CMS and a set of illustrations explaining the services of a young geoscience firm.
headline: First version live in two weeks
situation: GeoLinks, a geoscience data and consulting firm less than a year old, needed a website that could grow with the business and explain highly technical services simply.
task: Win the brief against established agencies, then design, build and launch the site and a visual language for its services.
action:
Ran a design sprint to a working first version, then adapted a flexible CMS with templates and custom widgets the client could manage himself.
Handled hosting, DNS, SEO metadata and monitoring, with cookie-less analytics so no consent banner was needed.
Created five illustrations, four for individual services such as ambient noise surface wave tomography and one for the firm as a whole, with variants for web and print.
result2_text: Google Lighthouse scores for performance, accessibility and SEO at launch
result3_text: Chosen over established agencies despite a higher quote

title: Research communications automation
summary: A redesigned research newsletter and a prototype portal that generates on-brand assets straight from research data.
headline: Newsletters and assets built from data, not by hand
tags: Email; Headless CMS; APIs; UX / UI
note: Parts of this project are confidential.
situation: INSEAD's research newsletters and communication assets were built manually from scattered databases.
task: Redesign the Research Quarterly and move asset creation towards an automated, data-driven process.

Redesigned the newsletter's visuals and code for consistent rendering and a low data footprint.

result2_text: Asset variants and formats generated from one source, usable in tools like Zapier, Make and Power Automate
